SELECT c.numero AS numero_contato, c.nome, c.grupo,
  COALESCE(s.ativa AND s.ultima_msg > now() - make_interval(mins => (SELECT valor::int FROM config WHERE chave='timeout_min')), false) AS em_sessao,
  (SELECT json_object_agg(chave, valor) FROM config) AS cfg
FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.numero = c.numero
WHERE c.ativo AND substr(c.numero,3,2) = substr($1,3,2) AND right(c.numero,8) = right($1,8)
LIMIT 1
WITH d AS (DELETE FROM history WHERE numero=$1) INSERT INTO sessions(numero,ativa,iniciada,ultima_msg) VALUES($1,false,now(),now()) ON CONFLICT (numero) DO UPDATE SET ativa=false RETURNING numero

SELECT $2::text AS texto, $3::text AS nome, COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('role',papel,'content',conteudo) ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id,papel,conteudo FROM history WHERE numero=$1 AND criado > now() - make_interval(mins => (SELECT valor::int FROM config WHERE chave='timeout_min')) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20) t),'[]'::json) AS hist, (SELECT valor FROM config WHERE chave='persona') AS persona, (SELECT valor FROM config WHERE chave='modelo') AS modelo, (SELECT string_agg('### ' || titulo || E'
' || texto, E'

' ORDER BY ordem, id) FROM knowledge WHERE ativo) AS conhecimento

WITH a AS (INSERT INTO history(numero,papel,conteudo) VALUES ($1,'user',$2),($1,'assistant',$3)), b AS (INSERT INTO sessions(numero,ativa,iniciada,ultima_msg) VALUES ($1,true,now(),now()) ON CONFLICT (numero) DO UPDATE SET iniciada = CASE WHEN sessoes.ativa AND sessoes.ultima_msg > now() - make_interval(mins => (SELECT valor::int FROM config WHERE chave='timeout_min')) THEN sessoes.iniciada ELSE now() END, ativa=true, ultima_msg=now()) SELECT 1 AS ok
